title: ProverIncentivesConfig
description:
Configuration of the prover incentives module. Specifies the minimum bond, the commitment to
the allowed verifier method and a set of initial provers with their
bonding amount.

initial_provers.description: A list of initial provers and their bonded amount.

minimum_bond.description: The minimum bond for a prover.

proving_penalty.description: A penalty for provers who submit a proof for transitions that were already proven

GasUnit(2).description: GasUnit is an array of size 2
